articles.title: Rajnath Singh urges IAF personnel to focus on cyber resilience and domain awareness

This focus is crucial for effectively countering complex and evolving emerging threats, ensuring India's national security preparedness in the contemporary strategic environment.

articles.title: Russian barrage hits Kyiv ahead of peace talks
articles.summary: Russian forces launched extensive overnight missile and drone attacks targeting energy infrastructure near Ukraine's capital, Kyiv. These assaults severely strained the city's power and heating systems as temperatures approached freezing. The continuous targeting of civilian infrastructure highlights Russia's strategy to disrupt essential services during winter, exacerbating humanitarian challenges for the Ukrainian population.

articles.title: Russia pounds power facilities around Kyiv, damages major bridge
articles.summary: Russian forces have launched extensive missile and drone attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, particularly around Kyiv. The ongoing strikes are a critical aspect of the conflict, impacting civilian life and highlighting the strategic targeting of essential services during winter, posing significant humanitarian challenges.
